objective: Partition the exact Tool Discovery residual after identity-scope closure into the region where universal program-side proof is information-theoretically admissible and the region where matched comparator evidence is irreducible.

partition.universal_region: Every admissible route that can still change the least-cost valid-route decision has all unresolved required capability facts safely probe-decidable; routes already disproved or strictly more expensive than a verified sufficient route cannot change the least-cost decision.
partition.matched_only_region: At least one admissible route can still change the least-cost valid-route decision while at least one required capability fact is neither currently evidenced nor safely probe-decidable.
partition.boundary_rule: The matched-only region is information-theoretically irreducible to a universal valid-plus-global-least-cost program theorem because observationally identical worlds can require different terminal actions.
